pr_title: gh-113257: Automatically generate pip SBOM metadata from wheel
pr_body:
Part of https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/112302
Closes https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/113257

This came up during https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/113249, basically we can actually automate pip's SBOM metadata because it's a part of a packaging ecosystem unlike most of the other dependencies in CPython's source tree.

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-113257 -->
* Issue: gh-113257
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->
pr_comments: This PR also fixes a bit of pip metadata, the SHA256 value for the package `downloadLocation` wasn't updated. I should add some automation to check those values match as well.
Thanks @hugovk, I've applied your suggestions in https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/113295/commits/5f33b3843b0fcd863964dcdf2e0aeea420ea9fd7

issue_context.title: Automate pip's SBOM package entry
issue_context.body:
# Feature or enhancement

### Proposal:

Part of https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/112302

Most of the vendored dependencies in CPython's source tree can't be automated due to being "outside" a package ecosystem therefore being difficult to automatically parse a version, pip however likely can be automated further since it's a Python package.

See https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/113249#issuecomment-1859961692 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/113249#issuecomment-1859979747

### Has this already been discussed elsewhere?

No response given

review_comments:
Noting we should also be fine in the case of build tags:

> The wheel filename is `{distribution}-{version}(-{build tag})?-{python tag}-{abi tag}-{platform tag}.whl`.

https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/binary-distribution-format/#file-name-convention
